title: Fig's Little Bridge
checkpoint: Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new alternative pronunciations ie as ee, ea as e, ou as oo.
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new alternative pronunciations ie as ee, ea as e, ou as oo.

pages.text: Fig gets to a gap by the pond.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar stopping at the edge of a small gap in the path, a pond on one side.

pages.text: The gap is too big to jump.
pages.illustration: A clear view of the gap, too wide for Fig to cross in one hop.

pages.text: Fig looks for bits lying round the pond.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar looking around at twigs, leaves and a flat shell scattered near the pond.

pages.text: Fig finds a long, flat twig.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar spotting a long, flat twig resting in the grass.

pages.text: Fig sets the twig across the gap.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar laying the twig carefully across the gap, forming a little bridge.
The twig bridge wobbling slightly as Fig tests it with one foot.

pages.text: Fig gets a flat shell to prop it up.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar wedging a flat shell underneath the middle of the twig bridge for support.
The twig bridge now steady and still, propped firmly by the shell.

pages.text: Fig crawls over the twig bit by bit.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar slowly crawling across the twig bridge over the gap.

pages.text: Fig made it to the other side.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar standing happily on the far side of the gap, the little bridge behind it.
